plugins.description: Knows which AI models you actually have (keys and subscriptions, live pricing), picks the right one for every task, routes it to a best-fit subagent, and proves what that saved. One open Agent Skills plugin for Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini CLI and Hermes.
